records.tagline: Move data using your terminal or agent. Fast & open source.

You can run Filament as a standalone binary or embed it in a Go application.

records.description: Stock research used by 5M+ investors a month. Decades of financials, analyst forecasts, full ETF holdings, a screener with hundreds of filters and an AI Analyst for 150,000+ stocks and funds worldwide. Fast, clean and mostly free.

records.name: VYRO IPTV
records.tagline: IPTV player for your own M3U and Xtream playlists
records.description: VYRO IPTV is a clean player for your own IPTV playlist on iPhone and iPad. Add your M3U playlist or Xtream Codes login and watch live TV, movies and series in one place. EPG with Now and Next, favorites, Picture in Picture, AirPlay, a Sports tab with live scores, profiles with PIN and iCloud sync. VYRO is a player only and does not include or sell any channels or playlists. Try it free for 7 days. Apple TV version is in App Store review. I'm the developer, Discord: https://discord.gg/2YBKzaW3hB

records.name: Keelson Merge Gate
records.tagline: A merge check for pull requests written by AI agents
records.description: Keelson Merge Gate checks every pull request before it merges, including the ones your coding agents open. It looks at CI, approvals, risky files and your policy, adds a deep review when a change needs one, and says plainly what it covered. Changes to workflows, Dockerfiles, infrastructure or CODEOWNERS always wait for a person. It is enforced once you make the check required in GitHub. Included with Keelson; free for up to three developers.

records.name: Nemeo
records.tagline: Compress videos. Not memories
records.description: Compress videos. Not memories. Nemeo makes your photo library lighter by thoughtfully optimizing videos, photos, and Live Photos, keeping your emotions and removing the extra megabytes. You can minimize the app and get on with your day while Nemeo optimizes in the background. Free up gigabytes, preserve quality, and keep the details that matter — dates, locations, favorites, and albums. Videos that need less space The videos you love stay with you while taking up significantly less storage.

records.name: Loomfy
records.tagline: Local and real-time meeting transcription, with summaries
records.description: Loomfy is a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that transcribes your meetings on your own computer, live or after you record. Get keyword alerts when an important term comes up, then a summary with topics, decisions and tasks. Chat with the meeting and get answers only from what was said, citing who said it. Export to PDF or Markdown. The Free plan has unlimited local transcription, with no minute limit. Paid plans add AI features, and Pro adds cloud transcription, including real time.

records.name: ClashXP
records.tagline: Pick a game. Challenge a friend. Settle it.
records.description: ClashXP brings multiple games together in one app: pool, Ludo, chess, basketball, bowling, darts, air hockey, ping pong, racing, mini golf, blocks, words and solitaire. Kito, our computer player, is always ready for a game. Start a match in seconds, practise your shots and learn every game at your own pace. Challenge a friend or find an opponent. You both play the same game and the best score wins the duel. Every duel moves your duel rating, so you always know where you stand.

records.name: Next Step UK
records.tagline: The digital ecosystem for athletes and sports clubs
records.description: Next Step UK gives football players a dedicated digital player card and professionally edited highlight reel to send directly to coaches with a single link. Instead of relying on scattered social media clips, players can present their key stats, footage, and profile in one clean place—while browsing and applying for real opportunities at every level, from local Sunday league squads and open trials to international academies and educational scholarships.

records.name: Vonsel
records.tagline: The AI-enriched Google Maps lead generator
records.description: Vonsel is an AI lead generator for agencies and sales teams that sell to local businesses. Tell the Vonsel AI who you sell to, or pick a business type and cities, and it searches Google Maps live, never an old list. Filter by no website, bad reviews, verified WhatsApp, email or rating, and pay only for the businesses that match. Export to Google Sheets, CSV or JSON, or work them in the built-in CRM. From 5 EUR per 1,000 businesses, 500 free credits, no subscription.

records.name: The First 5 Minutes
records.tagline: Stop overthinking. Start with one tiny action.
records.description: A practical guide for people who know what to do but struggle to start. Use the 2-Minute Physical Start method to turn overwhelming tasks into tiny, concrete actions—whether you're opening an assignment, replying to an email, or tackling a household task. Includes practical tools to make the first move easier.

records.name: Media Finder Pro
records.tagline: Scan, filter, and batch-organize media files in seconds.
records.description: Key Features: • High-Speed Scanning: Recursively scan drives and folders at 500+ files/sec, supporting 20+ media categories and 344+ file extensions, including video, audio, images, RAW, documents, and archives. • Instant Search: Filter results by filename, extension, or category. • Visual Preview: Preview destination subfolders before organizing files. • Safe Batch Organization: Copy or Move files with auto-rename, skip, or overwrite options and live progress tracking.

records.name: Calamnet Media Transcriber
records.tagline: Transcribe media into text, captions, and subtitles.
records.description: Turn audio and video recordings into transcripts, captions, summaries, and reusable content. Upload meetings, podcasts, interviews, lectures, webinars, social media clips, and everyday recordings. Media Transcriber transforms spoken content into clean, searchable transcripts, captions, meeting notes, podcast show notes, summaries, accessible reading formats, and reusable content—all from a single upload.

records.name: Streamdesk for Games
records.tagline: Track your game submissions in one workspace
records.description: Built an HTML5 game? Streamdesk helps indie developers discover publishing platforms, prepare releases and track submissions in one workspace. Explore potential publishing destinations, manage your release checklist, record submission progress and keep track of follow-ups. No more scattered notes and spreadsheets. Streamdesk keeps your publishing work organised while you stay in control of where and when to submit your game.

records.name: Code Regime Technologies
records.tagline: Custom software and mobile app development solutions.
records.description: Code Regime Technologies is a dynamic custom software and mobile app development firm. We specialize in building scalable digital products, high-performance blockchain solutions, and feature-rich white-label clone scripts for global startups and enterprises. From robust cross-platform mobile apps to secure decentralized architectures, we turn complex technological needs into market-ready solutions that accelerate business growth and digital transformation.

records.name: Claude Accounts
records.tagline: Your work and personal Claude, open side by side on Mac
records.description: Claude Desktop signs in to one account at a time. Claude Accounts gives each account its own Claude app with its own sign-in, Dock icon and color, all open side by side. Each profile also gets its own terminal command for Claude Code, links open in the account you pick, and you can move your current sign-in, MCP servers and extensions in without logging in again. It runs the original Claude app, so updates keep working. 30-day free trial, then $9.90 once.

records.name: Notion AI Inbox Blueprint
records.tagline: Turn messy texts and voice notes into organized Notion docs
records.description: Stop losing brilliant ideas in scattered chat apps and never suffer from "three-day Notion burnout" again. Drop raw thoughts via LINE, email, or voice apps—our no-code AI pipeline automatically transcribes, summarizes, tags, and files them into Notion 24/7. What's Inside: Step-by-step Make.com + OpenAI API no-code automation blueprint Copy-paste JSON prompts for instant titling, tagging & 3-line summaries Ready-to-use Notion AI Inbox database architecture & setup guide

records.name: Glocavo
records.tagline: Maps rankings, AI answers and GBP reviews in one app
records.description: New since our August launch: Glocavo, one app for local visibility. The Google Maps Rank Tracker scans a grid of points across your area. The AI Visibility Tracker checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI name you. The SERP Tracker follows your website's Google rankings. GBP Management handles reviews, posts and edits, and the Audit Widget turns agency website visitors into leads. Free plan with no time limit; paid plans from $21.99/mo.

records.name: FamSync
records.tagline: Free co-parenting app: custody calendar, expenses & chat
records.description: Free co-parenting app in 68 languages on iOS & Android. Manage shared custody calendars, overnights, swap requests, receipt OCR expenses, unalterable chat & SHA-256 PDF reports — free for both parents (optional €0.99/mo ad removal).

records.name: Papertrade
records.tagline: Paper trade 45 stock markets, or let your AI agent trade
records.description: Papertrade is a free paper-trading simulator for 45 stock markets, from NSE and NYSE to Tokyo, London and Hong Kong. Day-trade live prices or replay any past day minute by minute, with the real fees and taxes of 172 brokers like Zerodha, Robinhood and Trading 212. A built-in MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI agents trade too, so you can see if your AI makes good calls before it touches real money. Free, no card.

records.name: Vault Trade: Trading Journal for Windows
records.tagline: Trading Journal for Windows
records.description: A private trading journal for Windows. Log every trade, see your results on a calendar and heatmap, and keep all your data on your own PC. No subscription.

records.name: IBHighway
records.tagline: the premium AI toolkit for IB students
records.description: Eleven focused AI tools for IB Diploma students: BridgeSpeak, IB Mentor, AI Study Coach, Deadline Calendar, Misconception Analyzer, IA/EE/TOK project diaries that help students understand the assessment criteria, Research to Lab, ClarifyAI and UniApply.

records.name: Shelter41
records.tagline: Coding agents that keep working after you close your laptop
records.description: Run Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents in the cloud, each on its own isolated machine. Keep your repo, tools and conversation context together, move local sessions to the cloud, and let teammates pick up the work. Manage agents from the web, CLI or SDK, with no seat fees and per-second compute billing.

records.name: Smart Delivery Telegram Mini App
records.tagline: Smart Telegram delivery mini app with reward points
records.description: A professional Telegram Mini App with a live reward points system. Users subscribe and watch ads to collect points while enjoying a fast, smart ordering and delivery experience directly inside the chat.

records.name: advero
records.tagline: Helps young people build an E-Commerce store for $19.99
records.description: Young people these days need hundreds of dollars to start their dream business online mentors ask for thousands of dollars just to teach them Advero will meanwhile, let you build your store for free with only a $19.99 per month subscription fee it will provide you with thousands of products it will rank products from the most to least trending you can also sign into your E-commerce store with different devices at once with a single code at the same time. say no to thousands of dollars!

records.name: AI Partner
records.tagline: Free AI boyfriend & girlfriend — chat, voice, 500 love GIFs
records.description: AI Partner is a free AI companion app built solo by Rozeena (GearShift Digital, Pakistan). Choose from 4 boyfriends or 4 girlfriends — each with their own photo, voice and theme. Instagram-style chat with reactions and voice notes, 500 love GIFs, long-term memory, good-morning and birthday wishes, a gentle care mode, and 15 languages. No account needed; your data stays on your phone. Android APK: https://github.com/rossycoder/ai-boyfriend-app/releases/tag/apk-v1.4 — feedback very welcome!

records.name: PDFTransform
records.tagline: 100% Client-Side, Zero-Upload Private PDF Utilities
records.description: Merge, split, convert, organize, and watermark PDFs 100% offline in your browser. Zero file uploads, zero servers, and instant WebAssembly speeds.

records.name: Fable 5.2 Builds 4 Things From 2050
records.tagline: Build 3D games, a smart fridge, room twins and AI agents
records.description: What if 2050 is already here? I put Claude Fable 5.2 through four futuristic builds: a 3D cyberpunk racing game, a fantasy island builder, a Smart Fridge that suggests recipes from its inventory, and an interactive 3D digital twin for redesigning a living room. The final test creates an AI workforce with specialized agents for YouTube, courses, and newsletter research. These prototypes show how far AI-assisted building has come.

records.name: Neural Ranks
records.tagline: Track if AI cites your brand, by topic not by prompt
records.description: Neural Ranks shows whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews mention your brand. Instead of single prompts, it tracks topics: answer share, who gets cited instead of you, which sources the engines trust, and a monthly action plan.

records.name: Prompty
records.tagline: Stop writing prompts. Prompty writes them for you.
records.description: Prompty is a free Windows app that writes your AI prompts for you. Say what you want in plain words, and it writes a strong prompt, sends it to ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or Perplexity, and pushes back until the answer is actually good.

records.name: Orix
records.tagline: Run your business without the chaos.
records.description: Managing a business across multiple tools can get chaotic. Orix brings lead management, sales tracking, stock management, employee location tracking, client portals, and daily work management into one workspace. Get a clearer view of your operations, keep your team organized, track progress, and manage your business with less manual coordination. One workspace. Your whole business.

records.name: QuotaCrew for Codex
records.tagline: Switch accounts, resume chats, power down—all automatically
records.description: Now on the Microsoft Store: QuotaCrew for Codex is free and open source for Windows. Switch Codex accounts automatically. Resume your conversations automatically. Let your PC shut down when work is done. Built for Codex Desktop and VS Code, with quota tracking and local profiles. Automatic continuation is experimental and Codex-version dependent. Account switching restarts Codex Desktop; shutdown is optional.

records.name: VideoToPDF
records.tagline: Convert videos into searchable PDFs, transcripts & AI notes
records.description: VideoToPDF converts lectures, meeting recordings, podcasts, and tutorials into clean, searchable PDF documents online. Upload MP4, MOV, WEBM, MP3, or M4A files (up to 250MB on the Free plan) to generate timestamped transcripts with speaker labels, structured AI notes, chapter summaries, and key points, or combine video frames and images into PDFs directly in your browser.

records.name: Survive Dinner
records.tagline: Voice game: survive your nosy relatives at holiday dinner
records.description: A 2-minute voice game for the holidays. Pick your situation (still single, between jobs, moved back home) and three AI relatives, then answer their questions out loud. Make it to dessert and share your receipt. First dinner is free, no sign-up.

records.name: InSpiritInTruth
records.tagline: A real-life devotional app for imperfect journeys
records.description: A real-life devotional app for imperfect journeys. Devotionals you can tailor to your own unique life experience, rooted first in Scripture. A beautiful Bible reader, a journal and a verse and quote to help you through each day. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: Focus & Log
records.tagline: Focus in the moment. Log what happened.
records.description: Most productivity tools trap you in a cycle of overplanning and guilt: endless to-do lists, rigid schedules that break, and anxiety over broken streaks. Focus and Log is built on a different principle: honest contact with reality. Instead of signing rigid contracts with the future, Focus and Log gives you a calm, focused environment that unites clear daily priorities, rapid execution, and real-time accountability. Focus and Log narrows your day to what actually matters.

records.name: Why Bambo Viscose Sheet Keep Hot Sleeper
records.tagline: Most people blame the room, the duvet, or a late cup
records.description: The body needs to shed heat as it settles into sleep, and when bedding traps warmth against the skin, that process stalls. You wake up damp, kick off the covers, and repeat the cycle an hour later. The fiber is spun from bamboo cellulose into a smooth, drapey textile that feels cool at first touch and keeps moving moisture away instead of holding it close. That combination makes it a practical choice for anyone who runs warm,or simply wants bedding that feels lighter against the skin.

records.name: SEO Wires
records.tagline: Outrank the competition. Without writing a word.
records.description: Most AI tools only write articles. SEO Wires does your SEO. It studies your business and finds the competitors that rank above you on Google. It shows what they have that you don't, and why they are on top. Then it writes and publishes the posts that help you beat them.

records.name: Dynamic Notch
records.tagline: Notch for Windows
records.description: Dynamic Notch brings a sleek, interactive dynamic notch to Windows 10 and Windows 11. Built to stay completely out of the way until you need it, Dynamic Notch elevates your desktop workflow with real-time media controls, quick widgets, system levels, clipboard history, calendar events, focus timers, and quick file drop zones. System Levels: Real-time volume, brightness sliders, microphone mute toggle, and live CPU/RAM usage indicators.

records.name: ReelSave
records.tagline: mobile-first Instagram Reels & MP3 Downloader PWA
records.description: Save public Instagram Reels in 1080p HD, extract background MP3 audio, and download stories directly from your browser. Built entirely on mobile with zero logins required and full PWA install support. Without login

records.name: 2 Player Games - Play Offline
records.tagline: Two Players. One Phone. Endless Fun
records.description: Looking for 2 player games you can play offline? 2 Player Games - Play Offline is a collection of fun, quick mini games made for two players sharing one phone. Pass the device and compete head to head, or challenge the computer bot when you are playing alone. No internet connection needed. Take the game on a road trip, a train journey, a flight or during a power cut, and it still works. Pick a game and start playing in seconds. No login, no account, no sign-up and no waiting.

records.name: Sproutings: Outings with Kids
records.tagline: Parents find, review, and plan outings with you children.
records.description: Sproutings helps parents find, review, and share family-friendly activities like parks, museums, and playgrounds. No AI, irrelevant Google / Yelp reviews, or local Facebook groups. Sproutings provides a big map with the places real parents have visited and reviewed. It also provides tools to coordinate outings with friends and see where they've been. Get your kids out of the house and on an adventure with Sproutings!

records.name: TocaPad
records.tagline: Control your Mac without reaching for the keyboard.
records.description: Control your Mac without reaching for the keyboard. TocaPad turns your trackpad's edges and corners into controls: slide one finger up the right edge for volume or the left edge for brightness, and double-tap a corner to open Mission Control, show the desktop, lock your Mac, take a screenshot, play or pause, skip a track, open an app or press any shortcut you record. Open source (MIT), with no account and no analytics.

records.name: ExerciseGIF
records.tagline: Exercise GIFs that show which muscles work
records.description: ExerciseGIF is a library of exercise animations made based on real movement, with the working muscles highlighted on every clip. 265 exercises so far, each with steps, tips and muscle data, as GIF, WebP and MP4, with a female and a male figure. Change colors & background. Buy a muscle-group pack from $29 or the 250-exercise library for $249. An API and an MCP server for AI assistants are in early access.

records.name: Handpicked: Movies by People
records.tagline: Discover movies fast and easy based on unique human tastes
records.description: Looking for a movie, but tired of scrolling lists and reading threads? What you want is a person saying watch this. Handpicked is full of them. One deck of cards. Each card is a movie someone posted, with a pitch on why you should watch it. The deck is shuffled, not ranked: no algorithm decides what comes next, and no one is louder than anyone else.

records.name: Tinkrcat
records.tagline: Where kids build video games with AI and play with friends.
records.description: I built Tinkrcat to teach my kids how to use AI in a safe, fun way, starting with video games. Since launching, they've built lots of video games, and also, quizzes, flash cards, and tools to help with homework projects. What's been interesting is watching them dream something up, then creating it. I'd love for you (and your kids / nieces / nephews) to try it and let me know your thoughts.

records.name: LoadTest
records.tagline: Safe load testing for APIs and websites, with live metrics
records.description: Run realistic load tests on your HTTP APIs and websites. Verify domain ownership first, watch live p95/p99 latency, see why requests fail, and share workspaces and templates with your team. Request payloads are purged when a test starts. Free plan, no card.

records.name: Glotsmith
records.tagline: Your language course materials, with tools to study them
records.description: Keep your language course PDFs, notes and recordings together. Translate as you read, save vocabulary and study audio with timestamped transcripts. Built for adults learning from their own materials. Free to start.

records.name: DataMinimal
records.tagline: Data broker removal and privacy cleanup in one place
records.description: Get help removing your personal data from broker sites. DataMinimal sends supported removal requests, runs supported opt-out forms, and keeps replies and next steps together. Find exposed details, explore connected accounts, review breach records, and manage face-search, phone, career and social privacy tasks. $29/month or $300/year per adult. Data broker removals and automated opt-outs require US residence; coverage and verification vary.

records.name: Message to 2050
records.tagline: Write today. Nobody can open it until 2050, not even us.
records.description: A digital time capsule. Write a letter to someone you love and it's sealed with timelock encryption until January 1, 2050. The key doesn't exist yet: a global network of institutions (drand / League of Entropy) will create it that day. On Dec 31 the capsule closes in a "Midnight Wave" around the planet. English, Spanish and Portuguese.

records.name: FlowRec
records.tagline: The iPhone screen recorder with your face in every app
records.description: FlowRec 3.0 lets you record any app on your iPhone with your face in a floating bubble that follows you from app to app. On websites, a live green screen puts you right on the page, with no real green screen and no editing. Sonar rings show every tap, and a hidden teleprompter scrolls your script without appearing in the video. Made for app demos, tutorials, support answers, and reactions. Free to try; Pro removes the watermark and time limit.

records.name: Media Mine 360
records.tagline: Media Mine 360 is a full-service IT solutions agency
records.description: Grow your business with strategic SEO, paid advertising, website development, and digital marketing services. Explore Media Mine 360 and discuss your goals with our team.

records.name: Eyram: Journal & Manifest.
records.tagline: A private daily journal with prompts & mood tracking.
records.description: Eyram is a calm, private space to reflect, set intentions and become the woman you're growing into, one page at a time. Every day, Eyram gives you a gentle, personalized prompt. You answer honestly, by typing or with your voice, and add photos from your day like a real scrapbook journal. Unlimited prompts, your full archive, all themes and card styles, mood insights, tracked intentions and exclusive photo wallpapers. Monthly or yearly subscription, cancel anytime in Google Play.

records.name: SkiHub
records.tagline: Discover ski instructors and rental shops in Türkiye
records.description: Plan your next ski or snowboard day in Türkiye. Explore instructor profiles by resort, sport and lesson language, browse rental shops, and check weather forecasts for Uludağ, Erciyes and Palandöken. SkiHub brings the details together before you head to the mountain. Instructor listings do not guarantee availability; AI Match is still in development.

records.name: Image to Text (AI OCR Scanner)
records.tagline: Extract editable text from images & receipts in browser
records.description: Turn scanned documents, screenshots, and receipts into clean, editable text with 99% accuracy. Runs directly inside your browser with zero server uploads, keeping sensitive documents 100% private and free.

records.name: Hadayiq Fast Legal Translation, Dubai
records.tagline: Hadayiq Fast Dubai Legal Translation Portal
records.description: Customers upload documents, get a free AED quote, approve it and pay. A qualified translator is assigned with view-only access, then a second linguist proofreads. Customers track each stage and get the finished translation. Services cover legal translation (inside and outside the UAE), business documents and personal documents. Customers can also order by WhatsApp. If you need any dubai legal transaltion assistance, we're here.

records.name: SpendSense
records.tagline: See it. Stop it. Own it
records.description: SpendSense is a personal expense tracker that helps you monitor UPI transactions, record daily expenses, manage budgets, and understand your spending habits. Track your daily and monthly expenses, set spending limits, and analyse where your money goes, all in one place. Take control of your finances and make every rupee count. SpendSense – Know Your Spending. Own Your Money.

records.name: Fortnite Token Chance
records.tagline: Independent Fortnite chest-odds calculator
records.description: Estimate the chance of finding a Fortnite token from a chest count and an assumed drop rate, or calculate chests needed for a target probability. Includes a local chest tracker and event guides. Free, no login. Independent fan tool; not affiliated with Epic Games. No tokens are issued or guaranteed. Preset rates are reported figures, not independently verified current rates.

records.name: MoveNoble Moving Cost Calculator
records.tagline: What will your move cost? IRS migration + route data
records.description: Estimate what a move costs by route, home size, method, and month — a line-item range anchored to published averages and MoveNoble's route ledgers. It is free, runs entirely in your browser, and shows the model in full — estimates, not quotes.

records.name: PuppyOnTrack
records.tagline: A clearer care timeline and reports for your puppy
records.description: PuppyOnTrack now brings a continuous two-day care timeline and 7-, 30- and 90-day reports to your puppy’s routine. Track potty breaks, meals, water and health notes, share care with family, and keep separate records for each dog. Bathroom predictions, vet reminders and PDF health reports help you see what happened and what comes next. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: Keelson
records.tagline: Coordination and merge control for AI coding agents
records.description: Keelson coordinates AI coding agents working on the same codebase. Agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI report their current task and the files they intend to change, so overlapping work and conflicting edits are visible before they happen. A merge gate evaluates every pull request against CI, reviews and policy, and returns a decision with its reasons. Vendor-neutral. Free for teams of up to three developers.

records.name: 小蓝短剧 (Xiaolan Drama)
records.tagline: A short-drama app for Android, iOS, and the web.
records.description: Xiaolan Drama (小蓝短剧) is an app for watching short-form dramas, with official Android, iOS, and web entry points. The public website introduces recent titles and installation guidance. Stories on the site feature adult characters and are described in understated terms. Some features or titles may require a sign-in or payment, as shown in the app or web service. Use only official download links.

records.name: ProvenDecisions
records.tagline: Optimization problems, solved and proven
records.description: Type, photograph or say an optimization problem. ProvenDecisions builds the model, solves it with real solvers, checks every answer and walks you through the formulation step by step. Free for typed math, no account needed to try. Works on your phone.

records.name: Echoia
records.tagline: Free social media management platform
records.description: Echoia let you centralize and manage all your social media accounts in one place. Schedule posts, answer comments and DMs from one inbox. Or connect it to Claude or ChatGPT and just ask to make posts, answer comments, get your social accounts data and make automations with your AI agents. Compatible with Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky and Pinterest.

records.name: Kundli Milan
records.tagline: Free Karnataka-style kundli & marriage matching in Kannada
records.description: A free jataka and marriage-matching app done the way Karnataka families do it: Dashakoota with Rajju and Vedha, Chandramana panchanga, South Indian charts and dashas. Swiss Ephemeris accuracy, Kannada and English, PDF reports. No sign-up.

records.name: Wheel Plus
records.tagline: Spin the wheel and let luck decide
records.description: Wheel+ makes choices easy. Add your options, spin the wheel, and let luck decide! QUICK SETUP: Type your options and start spinning, with paste import for long lists SCENE TEMPLATES: 25 ready-made wheels for meals, classrooms, truth or dare, raffles and more CUSTOM RULES: Spin duration, tap to stop, remove-after-draw and other settings are yours SOUNDS & EFFECTS: Confetti and sparkle moments make every result feel special SPIN HISTORY: Every result is saved automatically.

records.name: SIARIX
records.tagline: AI Models Come and Go. Intelligence Shouldn't.
records.description: Siarix is an enterprise B2B cognitive control plane for autonomous, metacognitive AI with human governance. Powered by Mind Twin technology and model-agnostic BYOK, it preserves cognitive state, adapts to evidence, and enforces execution boundaries. Enterprises can reduce repeated AI work, prevent unauthorized actions, retain institutional intelligence, and scale auditable autonomy without sacrificing control.

records.name: leep
records.tagline: Always-on Team Intelligence for leaders
records.description: leep gathers what your Team knows without another meeting, call or message. Tell leep what you want to know (blockers, customer mentions, competitor moves). Each team member gets one short leep a day by email, Slack or Microsoft Teams and responds in seconds by voice or text, with no app or login. Every leep evolves based on what that person has already shared. You get Signals, Actions and a weekday Morning Brief, plus a Team Memory you can search or connect to your other AI tools via MCP.

records.name: Spyweb
records.tagline: Scrape and monitor the web from one self-hosted binary
records.description: Web scraping and monitoring usually means wiring together a runtime, browser, database, scheduler, and alerting. Or paying a SaaS. SpyWeb collapses that into one ~8MB self-hosted cross-platform binary: TOML jobs, Lua hooks, scheduling, dedupe, embedded storage, dashboard + programmable REST API, CDP automation (any CDP-compatible browser or endpoint, local or cloud), webhooks, hot reload, and a Lua test runner. Built for developers, self-hosters, and teams tracking prices, listings, and content.

records.name: Minesweeper Duo
records.tagline: Classic rules & Liquid Glass
records.description: The Minesweeper you remember, made native for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Two looks, classic rules, stats serious players use, a 60-level campaign and a Home Screen widget. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.

records.name: Gossip
records.tagline: Gossip links your devices together
records.description: Gossip links your devices together: notifications, clipboard, Do Not Disturb, media, screen mirroring and Universal Control. Direct on your local network, or through an optional end-to-end encrypted relay when you are away. No account. Mac and Android supported, Windows and Linux support coming soon.

records.name: AdChef®

records.name: MarketSignal
records.tagline: See which stocks the news is most positive about today

records.name: SSHL
records.tagline: Native SSH client for Mac: terminal and SFTP in one window
records.description: SSHL is a free, open-source SSH client for macOS. A terminal, an SFTP file manager and a server monitor share one window. It is pure Rust: GPUI draws the interface on the GPU, the Ghostty core (libghostty-vt) does terminal emulation, and there is no WebView, so a cold start takes about 0.3 seconds. The file manager follows the terminal's directory, saved sudo passwords fill in one click, and hosts import from ~/.ssh/config. GPL-3.0.

records.name: BioPulse
records.tagline: Greenhouse climate decisions, decided by physics
records.description: BioPulse is a free, real-time microclimate engine for greenhouses. Enter one reading — canopy temperature and humidity — and it calculates leaf VPD, condensation risk (IRF 0–100), and whether outside air can dehumidify your greenhouse for free (0 kWh passive ventilation). No simulated data, no account needed: if there's no real reading, it shows nothing instead of inventing numbers. Built by Leaftix, pairs with the BioStick ESP32 sensor for live readings.

records.name: MyEcuFile
records.tagline: Free ECU tools and tuning files for car tuners
records.description: MyEcuFile gives tuners and workshops a free toolkit to identify and read ECUs: ECU Detect, ECU Protocol Finder, ECU Locator Pro, OBD Locator Pro, DTC Remover and Auto Checksum. When you need a file, order tuned or original ECU files from a catalogue of real vehicles with Stage 1/2 horsepower and torque figures. Available in 12 languages, with simple credit-based pricing.

records.name: Bastion
records.tagline: Run each MCP server once, with credentials in the Keychain

One click wires Claude Code, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Cursor, Codex and more. 30-minute full trial, then a one-time $14.99.

records.name: AI Visibility Checker for Shopify
records.tagline: See if ChatGPT recommends your Shopify store, free

You get a report by email: who they recommend, whether it's you, and their exact words. Free, no sign up, about five minutes. By Shopkeeper SEO, the Shopify app that gets stores found on Google and in AI answers.

records.name: KaunsaCard
records.tagline: Which card saves you the most? Ranked in rupees

KaunsaCard brings offers from 25 banks and wallets into one place and ranks your cards by the rupees you'd actually save on your bill, after caps, weekday rules and minimum spends. Check before you pay.

records.name: TempMail.cat
records.tagline: A fresh inbox. No signup. Gone in an hour.
records.description: Keep your real inbox out of temporary signups. TempMail.cat gives you a free disposable email address in one tap—no account or password needed. Receive emails instantly, view styled HTML messages, and delete your inbox whenever you like. Each address expires after one hour, with automatic message cleanup. Built for mobile, available in English and Catalan, and wearing a little barretina.

records.name: GitThul
records.tagline: A free, open-source Git GUI with an integrated terminal
records.description: GitThul brings commit history, selective staging, conflict resolution and a split terminal into one desktop app. Review changes and choose what goes into each commit. Free and open source for Linux, Windows and macOS, with no usage telemetry.

records.name: PoE Atlas Docs
records.tagline: Plan your Path of Exile atlas tree and share it in one link
records.description: A free desktop companion for Path of Exile 1. Plan your Atlas passive tree with in-game style pathing (built from GGG's official tree data), keep farming notes and loot sheets in Word/Excel-style documents, and organise everything into profiles like Path of Building. Share a tree - or a tree plus all your notes - as one short link that opens right in the app. English & Russian UI, works offline, open source.

records.name: Night Train: Focus Rides
records.tagline: A focus timer where every session is a night train ride
records.description: Name what you're working on and start the ride. A night train leaves the station on a real railway line (Chur to St. Moritz through the Alps, Paris to Nice, Tokyo to Kyoto, Cairo to Aswan past the pyramids) and pulls into the platform exactly when your focus time ends. Real stations, a new night sky every ride, tickets and passport stamps. Focus rides and one line of your choice are free; Lifetime Pro is one purchase. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: Exporter
records.tagline: Apple Notes, Messages and Claude Code as Markdown files
records.description: Exporter turns Apple Notes, iMessage, Contacts, Reminders and Claude Code sessions into Markdown files on your Mac, and keeps them in sync as things change. Open them in Obsidian, give them to Claude or Cursor through the built-in MCP server, or keep them as a plain text backup. Free for your first 100 notes and 50 conversations. Each app unlocks with a one-time purchase, and Bear and Logseq are free.

records.name: Vironix AI
records.tagline: Know why a video works before you post it
records.description: Vironix AI watches your video, gives it a score out of 100 and tells you what to fix and where, with timestamps. Then it helps you write the next script and schedule the post. Made for small businesses, creators and agencies who want a content manager without adding a salary. There's a free plan with 100 credits and no card needed.

records.name: Scribase
records.tagline: One backend for your app, live in one command
records.description: One backend for your app: Postgres, Auth, Storage, Realtime and Functions, plus push notifications, store subscriptions, over-the-air updates and deep links, in one account. npx scribase init (or your coding agent via MCP) writes the keys into your app. Works with supabase-js. Instant branches, scale-to-zero, never paused for inactivity, full export. 1 project free with no time limit, no card; 14 days of Hobby to start; then Hobby $5/project, Pro $25/project, Studio $199/mo.

records.name: PartyDj

records.name: Cloud Doodle

Made to play alone or with your kids. No account, no ads, free forever, with an optional tip. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro, nine languages.

records.name: de:volt

Probe it with a 4-channel scope and multimeter, program an Arduino Uno or Nano, micro:bit or RP2040, learn with guided lessons that pass on real measurements, or run a whole class with assignments, marking and live lessons.

records.name: HarborIQ

No per-seat pricing. No contracts. Built for independent agencies.

records.name: CheckMarkdown

records.name: Acefolk

records.name: MergeMax

Premium is $2.99/month or $19.99/year.

records.description: Animdock is a free creative toolkit in your browser: procedural motion design templates you export to MP4, a royalty-free stock library of images, transparent PNGs, music and sound effects, and 20+ private online tools for images, video, audio and PDFs. No sign-up, no watermark.

Today, it's a marketplace for buyers and sellers; fleets get rent, dispatch, maintenance, and docs without patching tools.

records.name: SG MRT Rally
records.tagline: Collect stamps at Singapore’s MRT and LRT stations
records.description: Turn your train rides into a stamp rally. Explore Singapore’s MRT and LRT stations on an interactive map, find places to visit near each stop, and collect an illustrated stamp when you’re near a station exit. Keep your stamp book private or share it with a link. Free to use in English and Japanese, with passkey sign-in.

records.name: piscout
records.tagline: Find, control and flash your Raspberry Pis from Windows
records.description: One Windows window for your Raspberry Pis: LAN scan, SSH terminal, remote desktop, drag-and-drop upload, SD card flashing, and an MCP server so an AI assistant can use your Pis. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: Rogue Socials
records.tagline: Buy Social Media Accounts & SMM Services
records.description: Rogue Socials is a trusted marketplace to buy aged & fresh social media accounts (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitter, Snapchat) and affordable SMM boosting — with instant delivery and secure crypto & card payments.

records.name: Commniti
records.tagline: Share knowledge. Give help. Get help. Grow together.
records.description: A global peer contribution network for exchanging skills, practical assistance, and verified professional mentorship. Commniti is a peer-to-peer knowledge and help network. It enables members to join communities, participate in discussions, share skills, request assistance, collaborate and exchange community credits for contributions. It brings knowledge sharing and mutual help together in one platform.

records.name: The Doc Mirror
records.tagline: Scan and Improve Doctor's Online Visibility
records.description: A free doctor visibility checker that audits Google Search, Google Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude visibility.

records.name: Instagram Downloader
records.tagline: Instagram Downloader: Save Reels, Videos & Photos
records.description: Free Instagram downloader to save Reels, videos, photos, stories and highlights in HD. No login, no app, no watermark — just paste the link and download.

records.name: Okumovie: App Guide Maker
records.tagline: Make step-by-step video guides right on your phone
records.description: Okumovie makes it easier to create video guides right on your phone. Record a screen walkthrough, trim it, add tap and swipe hand cues, comments, images, or freeze frames, then export an MP4 to share. No desktop editor needed. Great for app tutorials, onboarding, and quick how-tos. Free to install on Android; sign-in is required. Recordings and drafts stay on your device, and gesture controls are optional. Exported videos include an Okumovie watermark; an ad may appear before in-app playback.

records.name: Kapiraš?
records.tagline: Learn Serbian with real videos, subtitles and quizzes
records.description: Kapiraš teaches Serbian through real videos, podcasts and stories. Tap any word in the subtitles to see its meaning, save it, and practice with quizzes built from what you just watched.

records.name: Replicate
records.tagline: Turn Webflow/Framer app into a Claude/Codex project for free
records.description: Replicate a Webflow, Framer, or any website-builder project into a NextJS app with 1:1 parity. Migrating off of website builders is difficult due to image CDNs, CMS parity, and minified JS code. Replicate handles all of these problems and commits your code to a GitHub repository. The best part? It's entirely free.

records.name: Flow Roadmaps
records.tagline: Step-by-step business roadmaps with AI on every step
records.description: Flow Roadmaps lays out the work of running a business in the order it goes. 49 roadmaps cover business functions, industries, software builds and technology, in numbered stages and steps. Every step has a short explanation, and Flow AI answers questions about any step using the roadmap you're reading. Free to read with no account; a new account starts with 9 free credits, about 3 questions.

records.name: Hybrid Plan MLM Software
records.tagline: Hybrid Plan MLM Software for Flexible Network Growth
records.description: Develop powerful Hybrid Plan MLM Software with integrated compensation structures, automated commission calculations, real-time genealogy tracking, e-wallet management, referral tracking, and secure payout processing. Customize MLM workflows to support efficient network operations and business expansion.
